findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Staff were observed donning gloves without handwashing. Education was carried out. The behavior was abolished. Ensure that employees are reminded to always wash their hands before donning lobbed in between tasks.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The nozzles on both soda machines were observed with an accumulation of soil including the knives in the holder in the back. Discussed with the PIC. The PIC pulled all the nozzles and knives out and instructed an employee to clean and sanitize them. Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the ones mentioned above are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The sanitizer in the bucket on the cook line was observed reading between 100-0 ppm. The PIC was made aware. A staff member was instructed to remake the sanitizer. The new sanitizer tested at 200 ppm. Ensure that the concentration of the sanitizer is monitored and replaced as required at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the trim tile on the wall right of the dry storage entrance upstairs to be coming off. The PIC was made aware. The PIC assured inspectors that that the trim tile will be sealed back to the wall. Ensure that the the trim tile is fix rendering the wall in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The caulking on the handwashing and triple sink are observed to be in a state of disrepair and need re-caulked. There are holes in the wall in the dry storage area that need to be sealed and made to be smooth and easily cleanable. Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair. 

PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.19: There is cardboard being used on the shelf under the grill that is observed to have an accumulation of grease on it. Cease using the cardboard and use a surface that can easily be cleaned. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following food contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. The ice scoop and the pan holding it. 
2. The utensil holder on the cook line. 
3. The can opener. 
4. The nozzles of the front ice cream machine.

Ensure that food contact surfaces are cleaned every 4 hours. A follow up will be conducted on 10/24/2024 to ensure these items have been cleaned. 

(A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: There were no sanitizer buckets made in the facility and the only buckets available were just soap. CORRECTED- Sanitizer buckets were made and tested to be at 200ppm of Quaternary ammonium. Ensure that there are always sanitizer buckets available to make sure food contact surfaces are being sanitized. 

 Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. The hood system is beginning to drip. Ensure that this area is cleaned to prevent any dripping onto food. 
2. The bottom and gaskets of the ice cream toppings cooler closest to the drive through. 
3. The milk cooler walls, door and gaskets. 
4. The nonfood contact surfaces of the ice cream machines. 
5. REPEAT- The surfaces of the chest freezer on the cook line. 
6. The syrup shelf. 
7. The walk-in cooler fans have dust build up. 

Ensure these nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned. 

 NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of being cleaned: 

1. REPEAT- The wall behind the shake mixer and along the cook-line. 
2. REPEAT- The floor near the edge of the cook-line near the triple sink. 
3. REPEAT- The floor of the walk-in freezer closest to the door. 
4. The wall above the mop sink. 
5. The floor underneath the fryer and grill has significant grease and debris build up. 

The facility has soil accumulation along the edges of the floors, in the gaps of entryways, and along floor junctions. The facility is in need of a deep cleaning of the floors and walls, specifically underneath the cook line. Ensure that physical facilities are cleaned and maintained cleaned. 

(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
